svg.title: Notification toast — new request (packaged app, deep-link)
svg.text: Toast — New waitlist request (deep-links to the request)
by D. Vance · Press P-12 · 0:42 left
Shown only when the per-user "Alert me on new requests" toggle is ON and the app is packaged (RuntimeHelper.IsMSIX).
Unpackaged or OFF = no-op fallback. Tapping deep-links via AppNotificationActivationHandler to the request detail.
